title: PR body still claims 'demolished terminals free the budget' although the same file's r1-fold section says that claim was amended
evidence:
PR body 'The district director' item 4: "4. **District caps**: `cap(d) = max(1, floor(pool_tiles(d) × permille /
   1000))`, gating BOTH families; demolished terminals free the budget
   (live counts derive from the topology)." — same file, r1 fold section: "- **W2: demolish-frees-budget acknowledged vacuous-by-design** — E2 forbids
  terminal demolish (validate_demolish_node → .Terminal_Demolish), so the
  live count is monotone within a run; the spec/PR/balance comments now
  say so instead of claiming verified behavior."
detail: The fold's claimed W2 fix ('acknowledged vacuous-by-design in the spec/PR comments') is contradicted inside the same PR body: the director section still asserts the freeing behavior unqualified. balance.json's _comment also never mentions it.
recommended_fix: Amend PR body item 4 to the vacuous-by-design wording (or delete the 'demolished terminals free the budget' clause), matching the r1-fold section and spec §1.4.

title: Two different outcomes reported for the same B1 bias-pin mutation leg (A=16 B=21 vs dead-even 27:27)
evidence:
PR verification section: "measured A=25 B=11
  weighted vs A=16 B=21 under the uniform-pick mutation, which FAILS the
  pin" — PR r1 fold (same pin, 'estate cap lifted, 10 windows × 6 seeds'): "uniform-pick mutation → 27:27 dead-even → FAILS)." — spec §3 item 3: "the honest 1.5× bar, mutation-verified: the uniform-pick mutation
   flips the sample to dead-even 27:27 and FAILS the pin"
detail: The pin (10 windows × 6 seeds) reports its mutation as A=16 B=21 in one place and 'dead-even 27:27' in two others; the memlog labels 27:27 a separate '6-seed run', so the spec/r1-fold attribution is wrong.
recommended_fix: Pick one canonical mutation number for the 10×6 pin (A=16 B=21); label 27:27 as the separate 6-seed diagnostic in spec, PR body, and memlog.
